summary.text: Dennis Bamburg is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 5, representing Bossier, Caddo, and Red River, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2023 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Dennis Bamburg's occupation as Allstate Insurance Agent.
It lists Dennis Bamburg's education as B.S., Business Administration, University of Louisiana at Monroe.
The House member page lists Dennis Bamburg's committee assignments as Insurance; Labor and Industrial Relations; Ways and Means; Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Central Louisiana Delegation Caucus; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
